v5: fix wheat-over-buying bug (BUY_PRODUCT WHEAT reserve check only counted shed stock, not wheat already picked up into hand inventories, so it kept re-buying at escalating scarcity prices nearly every turn) -- same proven 3/3 scale as v4. v6: progressive cash-health-gated reinvestment (buy another cow only once money >= 3x cost) replacing the fixed TARGET_STRUCTURES/HIRE_TARGET from v3-v5, plus a dynamic hire target tracking live+pending animals -- motivated by isolation testing showing fixed-target scale-up still underperformed the smaller baseline even with both known bugs (v4, v5) fixed

FINAL SELECTION: Reverting to v8: v9 scored 363.3 vs v8's 430.5 on the real leaderboard despite winning local self-play 57-65%. Across 43 real episodes herd size drives results (herd 7-8: 24% win rate, 9-10: 57%, 11+: 71%) and v9's feed-growing shrinks the median herd from 9 to 7. Local self-play couldn't see this because both sides were the same scale.

Fix feed-preempts-placement bug: 8 animals (~3700) sat unplaced in the shed from day 10 to season end while pastures stood empty, and pending animals counting toward MAX_STRUCTURES jammed the purchase gate at 7 placed + 8 pending = 15.

v10: stop buying animals while one is still waiting to be placed. Hands prioritise feeding over collecting from the shed, so once the herd is large enough that someone is always unfed at dawn, purchased animals are never collected -- measured at 8 animals (~3700) stranded in the shed from day 10 to season end. Letting hands collect them instead measured 0W-20L (over-expansion collapse), so the ceiling is correct; only the wasted purchases were the bug.

FINAL SELECTION: Stops buying animals while one is still pending. 8 animals (~3700) were being stranded in the shed from day 10 to season end because hands always prioritise feeding over collection once someone is unfed at dawn. Letting hands collect them instead measured 0W-20L (over-expansion collapse), so the herd ceiling is correct -- only the wasted purchases were the bug. 100% vs random/starter/greedy at 42-49k and 100% vs v8 (14W-0L).
